howToUse.title: Describe Your Pattern
howToUse.description: Go to the AutoRegex website and enter a plain language description of the pattern you want to convert to regex.

howToUse.title: Get Regex Output
howToUse.description: The tool instantly generates a regular expression based on your input.

howToUse.title: Copy or Edit Regex
howToUse.description: Copy the generated regex or use syntax highlighting and tools to further refine it.

howToUse.title: Learn Regex Concepts
